# Parley v0.1.12

This beta fixes Ghostty resource packaging so Parley can start after being
installed on a different Apple Silicon Mac.

## Fixed

- Parley no longer relies on an absolute SwiftPM build-machine path when
  Ghostty initializes.
- Ghostty's library data, terminfo, themes and shell integration are packaged
  in `Parley.app/Contents/Resources` and resolved from that signed location.
- Release builds apply a narrow, temporary resource-resolution overlay to the
  official `libghostty-spm` checkout, compile it, and restore the checkout.
  Parley therefore remains pinned to the official wrapper without maintaining
  a fork.
- Packaging fails closed if the expected upstream wrapper source changes.
- The package contract verifies the complete Ghostty resource bundle before
  signing or creating release archives.

## Upgrade notes

- Quit Parley before replacing the existing application. Quitting ends its
  live pane processes and app-resident coordination core.
- Workspace definitions and local collaboration history remain compatible.
- Agent protocol v9 is unchanged, so existing v9 panes do not require a
  protocol restart.

## Install and trust

- Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
- At least one supported, installed and signed-in vendor CLI.
- Download `Parley-0.1.12-mac-arm64.dmg`, quit Parley, replace `Parley.app` in
  Applications, and reopen it normally from Finder.
- This beta is ad-hoc signed and is **not notarized**. Use **System Settings >
  Privacy & Security > Open Anyway** only when the files came from this expected
  release. Never disable Gatekeeper globally.

Use `Parley-0.1.12-mac-arm64.SHA256SUMS` to verify every downloaded artifact.
